title: Cobalt Arc Post Frames (Cropped View)
whatItIs: A cropped screenshot of the same four Instagram frames: a cobalt post with a white headline over concentric arcs, a grey post with fine arcs, a split post with a phone photo above a cobalt band and a grey post with a big cobalt half-disc holding a ring logo, labelled 'Image not included'.
whatItMeans: A single circle motif in two colours gives four different layouts one consistent identity.
techniques: Cobalt and grey as the only colours
Ring logo repeated in each post

vocabulary.definition: Concentric curves used as a signature pattern.
A caption stating that a photo is not part of the template.
The platform's header and action icons around a post.
